column2: Pant, pant... Ah... my head hurts so baaad!!
Ugh... it tastes weird...
But, but, but... I don't want you going out all on your own...
Pant, pant... B-$$おにいちゃん$$...
My tummy feels all...
Piro-piro-goro-kyoooom... sort of...
Pant, pant... U-ugh... I feel sick...
Sorry, $$おにいちゃん$$...
I already have lots of the same thing... so I don't need this one!
B-Big bro-ther...?
You... won't take the $$プレゼント$$ from me...
N-No, it's okay! Don't worry about it!
You're so nice, $$おにいちゃん$$...
Thanks! *smooch*!!
Waaah! So $$かぁわい〜い$$!!
Huh!? You're giving it to me? Thank you! Heehee, I'm so happy!
Thanks, $$おにいちゃん$$. Kupu-pupu... I know what you want! You want to eat my cooking, don't you?
Just wait and see—!!
Yaaay, thank you! Now I can make yummy $$スープ$$!
And I've got fresh $$こけももジャム$$ too!
So huge! You caught a big one!
Okay! Then I'll cook you something yummy!
(Maybe $$ブルーベリー$$ are the secret ingredient...)
...Thank you!
I just can't help feeling a little sorry for it...!!
Thaaank you, $$おにいちゃん$$!
Next time, could we go pick $$ブルーベリー$$ together too?!
H-How did you get this...??
D-Don't tell me $$おにいちゃん$$ killed the little animals!?
...I'm sorry, $$おにいちゃん$$...!
(Why can't $$おにいちゃん$$ understand this flavor...?)
Eek!! $$おにいちゃん$$, you big meanie, meanie, meanie!
You... read my $$日記$$?
Grrr! I'm so, so maaaad!!
Hey, hey... where did you find thiiis...?
D-Don't tell me you didn't look inside, right!? Right!?
Hey, hey... where did you find thiiis...?
I'm so happy! Even though your $$記憶$$ is all mixed up, you still remembered my $$誕生日$$!
Heeheehee...!
W-Well? Does it look good on me...??
Huh? What kind of sweet is this!?
Oh, it's not...? Sorry, $$おにいちゃん$$... *sniff*
Whaaat!? Is this... really okay?
Yaaay!! Thank you, $$おにいちゃん$$!!
W-W-Whoa!! Where did you find something like this!?
Biiig broooother!!
Eek! No, no...!!
Oh, um, it's nothing. Th-Thank you, $$おにいちゃん$$...
Thank you—it's so $$かわいい$$!!
Hey, hey! What should we name it, $$おにいちゃん$$!!
Yaaay!! Thank you, $$おにいちゃん$$!!
D-Don't tell me... you went and got $$薬$$ for me...?
Honestly... $$おにちゃん$$, you big, big, big dummy!!
I-I-It's amaaazing! Or... I think it might be...
W-W-W-What is this?
Noooooo!!
So $$かわいい$$!!
Aww, thank you! But if I take this...
What am I supposed to doooo with it?
(Why did $$おにいちゃん$$ give me this, I wonder?)
Heeheehee, then this is...
A $$プレゼント$$ from me! Will you take it, $$おにいちゃん$$?
